name: When should I consider installing a permanent wheelchair ramp versus a temporary one?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider installing a permanent wheelchair ramp versus a temporary one?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a permanent wheelchair ramp if accessibility is a long-term need for a resident, or if you want a solution that integrates seamlessly with your home's design and landscaping. Permanent ramps, typically made of wood or concrete, offer superior stability, durability, and often require less daily effort. Temporary or modular ramps are better for short-term needs, when flexibility is important, or when you need a less invasive solution. We can help assess your situation to determine the most suitable option.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install a permanent ramp for long-term needs and aesthetic integration. Opt for a temporary or modular ramp for short-term use, flexibility, or less invasive solutions.
